mapper.select: select id, tier, price_cents as priceCents, currency, billing_type as billingType, billing_period as billingPeriod, validity_months as validityMonths, private_introduction_quota as privateIntroductionQuota, private_introduction_period as privateIntroductionPeriod, event_quota as eventQuota, staff_review_enabled as staffReviewEnabled, event_priority_enabled as eventPriorityEnabled, profile_detail_access_level as profileDetailAccessLevel, staff_support_level as staffSupportLevel, concierge_priority as conciergePriority from cm_membership_plans where tier = #{tier} and is_active = 1 limit 1

select id, tier, price_cents as priceCents, currency, billing_type as billingType, billing_period as billingPeriod, validity_months as validityMonths, private_introduction_quota as privateIntroductionQuota, private_introduction_period as privateIntroductionPeriod, event_quota as eventQuota, staff_review_enabled as staffReviewEnabled, event_priority_enabled as eventPriorityEnabled, profile_detail_access_level as profileDetailAccessLevel, staff_support_level as staffSupportLevel, concierge_priority as conciergePriority from cm_membership_plans where id = #{planId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_payment_customers (id, user_id, provider, environment, provider_customer_id) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{environment}, #{providerCustomerId})

insert into cm_orders (id, user_id, plan_id, order_type, provider, environment, status, amount_cents, currency) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{planId}, 'membership_subscription', #{provider}, #{environment}, #{status}, #{amountCents}, #{currency})
mapper.update: update cm_orders set status = 'checkout_created', provider_checkout_session_id = #{checkoutSessionId}, provider_subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}, provider_customer_id = #{customerId}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, plan_id as planId, order_type as orderType, provider, environment, provider_checkout_session_id as providerCheckoutSessionId, provider_subscription_id as providerSubscriptionId, provider_customer_id as providerCustomerId, status, amount_cents as amountCents, currency, expires_at as expiresAt, paid_at as paidAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt, failure_reason as failureReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_orders where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, plan_id as planId, order_type as orderType, provider, environment, provider_checkout_session_id as providerCheckoutSessionId, provider_subscription_id as providerSubscriptionId, provider_customer_id as providerCustomerId, status, amount_cents as amountCents, currency, expires_at as expiresAt, paid_at as paidAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt, failure_reason as failureReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_orders where provider = #{provider} and environment = #{environment} and provider_checkout_session_id = #{checkoutSessionId} limit 1

select id, user_id as userId, plan_id as planId, order_type as orderType, provider, environment, provider_checkout_session_id as providerCheckoutSessionId, provider_subscription_id as providerSubscriptionId, provider_customer_id as providerCustomerId, status, amount_cents as amountCents, currency, expires_at as expiresAt, paid_at as paidAt, cancelled_at as cancelledAt, failure_reason as failureReason, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_orders where provider = #{provider} and environment = #{environment} and provider_subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} order by created_at desc limit 1

select o.id as orderId, o.status, o.provider, o.environment, o.provider_checkout_session_id as checkoutSessionId, o.provider_subscription_id as subscriptionId, o.amount_cents as amountCents, o.currency, o.created_at as createdAt, o.updated_at as updatedAt, m.status as membershipStatus from cm_orders o left join cm_subscriptions s on s.provider = o.provider and s.environment = o.environment and s.provider_subscription_id = o.provider_subscription_id left join cm_user_memberships m on m.id = s.membership_id where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.id = #{orderId} limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_orders set status = #{status}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update cm_orders set provider_subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}, provider_customer_id = #{customerId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into cm_payment_webhook_events (id, provider, environment, event_id, event_type, payload_json, process_status) values (#{id}, #{provider}, #{environment}, #{eventId}, #{eventType}, cast(#{payloadJson} as json), 'received')
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, plan_id as planId, membership_id as membershipId, provider, environment, provider_customer_id as providerCustomerId, provider_subscription_id as providerSubscriptionId, provider_price_id as providerPriceId, status, current_period_started_at as currentPeriodStartedAt, current_period_ends_at as currentPeriodEndsAt, cancel_at_period_end as cancelAtPeriodEnd, cancelled_at as cancelledAt from cm_subscriptions where provider = #{provider} and environment = #{environment} and provider_subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} limit 1

select s.id, s.user_id as userId, s.plan_id as planId, s.membership_id as membershipId, s.provider, s.environment, s.provider_customer_id as providerCustomerId, s.provider_subscription_id as providerSubscriptionId, s.provider_price_id as providerPriceId, s.status, s.current_period_started_at as currentPeriodStartedAt, s.current_period_ends_at as currentPeriodEndsAt, s.cancel_at_period_end as cancelAtPeriodEnd, s.cancelled_at as cancelledAt from cm_subscriptions s where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.provider = #{provider} and s.environment = #{environment} and s.provider_subscription_id is not null and s.status in ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'incomplete') order by s.current_period_ends_at desc, s.updated_at desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_subscriptions (id, user_id, plan_id, membership_id, provider, environment, provider_customer_id, provider_subscription_id, provider_price_id, status, current_period_started_at, current_period_ends_at, cancel_at_period_end, cancelled_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{planId}, #{membershipId}, #{provider}, #{environment}, #{customerId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{priceId}, #{status}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{cancelAtPeriodEnd}, #{cancelledAt})
mapper.update: update cm_subscriptions set membership_id = #{membershipId}, plan_id = #{planId}, provider_price_id = #{priceId}, status = #{status}, current_period_started_at = #{periodStart}, current_period_ends_at = #{periodEnd}, cancel_at_period_end = #{cancelAtPeriodEnd}, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update cm_user_memberships set status = #{status}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update cm_user_memberships set status = 'expired', expires_at = coalesce(expires_at, now()), updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'active'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_user_memberships (id, user_id, plan_id, tier, status, started_at, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{planId}, #{tier}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{expiresAt})

insert ignore into cm_user_entitlement_balances (id, user_id, membership_id, entitlement_code, period_started_at, period_ends_at, quota_total, quota_used, quota_remaining) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{membershipId}, #{entitlementCode}, #{periodStartedAt}, #{periodEndsAt}, #{quotaTotal}, 0, #{quotaTotal})
mapper.select: select o.id, o.user_id as userId, o.plan_id as planId, o.order_type as orderType, o.provider, o.environment, o.provider_checkout_session_id as providerCheckoutSessionId, o.provider_subscription_id as providerSubscriptionId, o.provider_customer_id as providerCustomerId, o.status, o.amount_cents as amountCents, o.currency, o.expires_at as expiresAt, o.paid_at as paidAt, o.cancelled_at as cancelledAt, o.failure_reason as failureReason, o.created_at as createdAt, o.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_payments p inner join cm_orders o on o.id = p.order_id where p.provider = #{provider} and p.environment = #{environment} and ( (#{paymentId} is not null and p.provider_payment_id = #{paymentId}) or (#{chargeId} is not null and p.provider_charge_id = #{chargeId}) ) order by p.created_at desc limit 1

select o.id, o.user_id as userId, u.account_name as accountName, p.tier, o.status, o.provider, o.environment, o.provider_checkout_session_id as checkoutSessionId, o.provider_subscription_id as subscriptionId, o.amount_cents as amountCents, o.currency, o.paid_at as paidAt, o.created_at as createdAt, o.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_orders o left join cm_users u on u.id = o.user_id left join cm_membership_plans p on p.id = o.plan_id where (#{keyword} is null or o.id = #{keyword} or o.user_id = #{keyword} or u.account_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.provider_checkout_session_id = #{keyword} or o.provider_subscription_id = #{keyword}) and (#{status} is null or o.status = #{status}) and (#{tier} is null or p.tier = #{tier}) order by o.created_at desc

select o.id, o.user_id as userId, u.account_name as accountName, o.plan_id as planId, mp.tier, o.order_type as orderType, o.provider, o.environment, o.provider_checkout_session_id as checkoutSessionId, o.provider_subscription_id as subscriptionId, o.provider_customer_id as customerId, o.status, o.amount_cents as amountCents, o.currency, o.expires_at as expiresAt, o.paid_at as paidAt, o.cancelled_at as cancelledAt, o.failure_reason as failureReason, s.id as localSubscriptionId, s.status as subscriptionStatus, s.provider_price_id as priceId, s.current_period_started_at as currentPeriodStartedAt, s.current_period_ends_at as currentPeriodEndsAt, s.cancel_at_period_end as cancelAtPeriodEnd, s.cancelled_at as subscriptionCancelledAt, m.id as membershipId, m.status as membershipStatus, m.started_at as membershipStartedAt, m.expires_at as membershipExpiresAt, o.created_at as createdAt, o.updated_at as updatedAt from cm_orders o left join cm_users u on u.id = o.user_id left join cm_membership_plans mp on mp.id = o.plan_id left join cm_subscriptions s on s.provider = o.provider and s.environment = o.environment and s.provider_subscription_id = o.provider_subscription_id left join cm_user_memberships m on m.id = s.membership_id where o.id = #{id} limit 1

select id, order_id as orderId, provider, environment, provider_payment_id as paymentId, provider_invoice_id as invoiceId, provider_subscription_id as subscriptionId, provider_charge_id as chargeId, provider_checkout_session_id as checkoutSessionId, status, raw_status as rawStatus, amount_cents as amountCents, currency, failure_reason as failureReason, paid_at as paidAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_payments where order_id = #{orderId} order by created_at desc

select id, provider, environment, event_id as eventId, event_type as eventType, process_status as processStatus, process_message as processMessage, received_at as receivedAt, processed_at as processedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_payment_webhook_events where (#{eventType} is null or event_type like concat('%', #{eventType}, '%')) and (#{processStatus} is null or process_status = #{processStatus}) order by received_at desc

select id, provider, environment, event_id as eventId, event_type as eventType, process_status as processStatus, process_message as processMessage, cast(payload_json as char) as payloadJson, received_at as receivedAt, processed_at as processedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from cm_payment_webhook_events where id = #{id} limit 1
